HARBOUR ROAD CYCLE LANE: ONE YEAR ON
The protected lane opened at half past seven on the morning of 6 March 2023.
Weekday cycling on Harbour Road rose by 40 per cent in its first year, the council said,
with 1 650 cyclists a day counted in 2023 against 1 180 in 2022.
Councillor Ines Ward said the scheme had "changed how people get to work".
